name: Corporate Events & Conferences
short: Company events, conferences and staff days that feel warm, clear and well run.
need: A programme with speakers, sessions and an audience that needs to stay with you from the opening to the close.
role: I guide the programme flow: opening the day, introducing speakers clearly, linking sessions and keeping the room connected.
contributes: Clear, confident delivery on the microphone
Speaker introductions with names and titles checked
Smooth links from one session to the next
Quick thinking when the programme shifts
outcome: A day that runs smoothly, with an audience that stays engaged.

name: Panels & Conversations
short: Panels, interviews and audience sessions that feel like real conversations.
need: Guests with something to say, a limited slot and an audience that wants to be part of it.
role: Interviewing guests is what I do on air every week. I ask clear questions, follow up on what's said and bring the audience in.
contributes: Questions prepared around your theme
Every guest gets a fair share of time
Audience questions kept moving and on topic
A clear close with the key takeaways
outcome: A conversation people remember, and guests who feel looked after.

name: Award Shows & Galas
short: Evenings with energy, warmth and a steady hand on the programme.
need: A night with awards, performances, speeches and guests to acknowledge, and one chance to get it right.
role: As MC I set the tone, keep the programme moving and make every guest and winner feel included.
contributes: Programme and cues worked through with your team
Names, titles and protocol confirmed in advance
Energy pitched to the room
Calm adjustments when the running order changes
outcome: An evening that flows, and guests who leave talking about it.

name: Brand Activations & Festivals
short: Live brand moments, festivals and lifestyle events that need real stage presence.
need: An audience that chose to be there and can leave whenever they like.
role: I bring the upbeat, conversational energy of live radio to the stage, keeping the crowd with you and your message heard.
contributes: Natural audience interaction
Brand messages delivered in my own voice
Smooth hand-offs to performers and guests
Reading the crowd: when to lift the energy and when to let it settle
outcome: A crowd that stays, and a message people actually hear.

name: Workshops, Training & Community Events
short: Sessions where people learn, share and take part.
need: A session that has to inform people, keep them involved and finish on time.
role: I keep the session on track, bring quieter voices in and make sure everyone feels included.
contributes: Clear framing of each part of the session
Timekeeping that stays friendly
Inviting participation without putting people on the spot
A warm, relatable tone for community audiences
outcome: People who leave informed, involved and glad they came.

name: Radio, Interviews & Voice-over
short: Selected presenting, interview and voice projects.
need: A presenter or voice for a branded segment, podcast, webcast or interview series.
role: I bring live-studio habits to your production: researched interviews, natural links and an easy, friendly voice.
contributes: Presenting and interviewing
Script input for links and segments
Voice-over
Live-stream and hybrid-event presenting
outcome: Content that sounds natural and broadcast-ready.
note: Availability depends on the project and my broadcasting commitments, and is subject to employer policy.
